_description: Monthly retirement spending with yearlyDecreasePercent explicitly set to 0 — verifies that zero is treated as 'no decay', not ignored. No growth, no inflation, no income.
_rationale: 500k savings, 60k/yr flat spending (0% yearly decrease) starting at age 60. Spending stays constant at 60k/yr. With Florida (no state tax) and federal standard deduction, effective tax is low. Portfolio depletes faster than the 5% decrease scenario because spending never decays.
name: Yearly Decrease Percent Zero
